title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | K-IG 교육 ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육- 161 ]

blocks.text: I have seen on TV and read about many successful people
such as Bill Gates, Ban-Gi-Moon, and Angelina Jolie.
These people have influenced me a lot in one way or another.
A few years ago, Queen Elizabeth II came to Korea.
She had an interpreter with her who was very professional.
Her ability to interpret so well had a great affect on me.
It has impressed me enough to want to become an interpreter.
